description:
Emmavie reveals her EP ‘What’s A Diamond To A Baby’. Self-produced by Emmavie herself, except previous single ‘Uh Huh Okay’ produced by ROMderful, Emmavie fuses digitally produced future R&B sounds and live instrumentation on the seven-track EP. Features come from the lyrical stylings of East London rapper Kojey Radical, multi-talented jazz musician Alfa Mist and hip hop legend Phonté on lead track ‘Be Mine’, plus many more.

Always expressing the most complex parts of herself through making music, speaking about the EP Emmavie explains; “What’s A Diamond To A Baby’ is a capsule. I wanted to capture a moment that would have people hear me both as how they’ve come to know me and how they’ve never heard me before. The brief was sexy and playful so I captured this in a range of sounds and ideas, shifting gears between contemporary R&B styles, whilst still honouring my signature sound and my biggest inspiration, love. I set the tone opening the project with the naughtiest song on the EP, ‘Trick Me’ featuring Kojey Radical, letting listeners know we’re diving straight in at the deep end”.

Emmavie is a recipient of the PPL Momentum fund and this release is supported PPL UK, Spotify UK, Creative Scotland, Arts Council of Wales, Welsh Government, Arts Council of Northern Ireland.
